faq.a: Ambrosia is an officially named destination in the fictional state of Leonida. Rockstar's official screenshot library includes a dedicated Ambrosia collection, and its artwork library has an Ambrosia postcard, confirming it as part of the game's setting rather than a fan-made map label.

faq.q: Is Ambrosia part of Vice City in GTA 6?
faq.a: No. Official material presents Ambrosia as a distinct environment within Leonida, separate from Vice City's dense urban core, and associated instead with inland industry and working-class surroundings.

faq.q: When was Ambrosia first shown in GTA 6?
faq.a: Ambrosia first appeared in Trailer 2, released on 6 May 2025, as part of Rockstar's wider reveal of locations across Leonida.

faq.q: What kind of environment does Ambrosia represent in GTA 6?
faq.a: Rockstar's material associates Ambrosia with inland industry and working-class surroundings, based on Florida's interior and agricultural-industrial areas. A detailed description of its streets or buildings has not been published.

faq.q: Where exactly is Ambrosia located on the GTA 6 map?
faq.a: Rockstar has not published a complete district map, official boundaries, or exact coordinates for Ambrosia. It is confirmed as part of Leonida, but its precise position within the state has not been stated.
